(View on map) Posted: 1 week ago Openings: 3 Applicants: 100+ Continue with Google Job description JOB DESCRIPTION: Business Analyst 6-8 years Business Analyst play a pivotal role in managing communication and ensuring the smooth execution of projects. Their responsibilities and required skills are similar to those of project coordinators but with a heightened emphasis on communication and stakeholder management. Here are the key skill sets and responsibilities for Project SPOCs: Key Responsibilities Communication Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications between the project team and stakeholders. Ensure clear and consistent communication channels are maintained. Relay important information and updates from stakeholders to the project team and vice versa. Stakeholder Management: Identify and understand the needs and expectations of all stakeholders. Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders. Manage stakeholder expectations and address concerns promptly. Coordination and Facilitation: Coordinate project activities and ensure alignment with project objectives. Facilitate meetings, discussions, and negotiations between the project team and stakeholders. Ensure that project goals, timelines, and deliverables are clearly communicated and understood by all parties. Issue and Risk Management: Identify potential issues and risks that may impact the project. Communicate risks and issues to stakeholders and ensure appropriate mitigation strategies are in place. Act as a mediator to resolve conflicts and issues as they arise. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain comprehensive and accurate project documentation. Prepare and distribute regular project status reports to stakeholders. Ensure that all project communications are documented and easily accessible. Key Skills Excellent Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely. Active listening skills to understand stakeholder concerns and requirements. Interpersonal Skills: Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders. Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills. Empathy and emotional intelligence to manage stakeholder emotions and expectations. Organizational Skills: Excellent time management and prioritization skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously. Attention to detail to ensure accurate and thorough documentation. Project Management Knowledge: Understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and best practices. Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Asana, Trello, JIRA). Knowledge of the specific industry and domain of the project. Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills: Ability to identify potential problems and develop effective solutions. Critical thinking skills to analyze situations and make informed decisions. Risk management skills to proactively identify and mitigate project risks. Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with the technical aspects of the project (if applicable). Ability to understand and communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders. Adaptability and Flexibility: Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and stakeholder needs. Willingness to learn new skills and tools as required by the project. Leadership and Motivation: Ability to lead and motivate the project team. Delegation skills to assign tasks appropriately. Decision-making skills to make timely and effective decisions. By excelling in these areas, Project SPOCs can ensure effective communication, alignment, and successful delivery of project objectives, thereby playing a crucial role in the overall success of the project.
